title: With the riches taken from Qashtāla, the Emperor Ismāʿīl orders a madrasa built in every town and city of the empire, not only in the lands the crown holds directly but in the ṭāʾifas too

data.funding: the wealth taken from Castile in the War of Jillīqiya (the treasury stood at 816 after the Peace of Rajab)
data.scope: every town and city, the ṭāʾifas included (Trent's account, read as 'not just the ones held directly by the crown')

title: The Emperor's second order, made in honour of his father: the law of the Education of the People. Knowledge is declared the right of every subject, burgher, peasant, labourer and soldier alike, to the displeasure of the umarāʾ and the ʿulamāʾ

data.law: Education of the People (education of the masses)
data.text: knowledge and education are two of the most enriching aspects in anyone's life, and therefore the state must ensure our people have access to both. We are all born with free will and free thought, and it is the state's duty to preserve these natural rights, which are held by all our people (the game's text)
